adjudication.rationale: Looking at app/models/topic_embed.rb lines 12-16, the code appends a localized footer to contents before computing content_sha1 on line 17. This means if the locale text changes (I18n.t('embed.imported_from')), the SHA1 will differ even though the actual source content hasn't changed, triggering unnecessary post revisions. The finding correctly identifies this as a design flaw where presentation text is coupled with source-change detection.
